/**

// Analysis types supported by SPICE

export interface SimResult {
  header: string;
  numVariables: number;
  variableNames: string[];
  numPoints: number;
  dataType: 'real' | 'complex';
  data: Array<{
    name: string;
    type: string;
    values: number[] | Array<{ real: number; img: number }>;
  }>;
}

export interface CompactSummary {
  analysisType: AnalysisType;
  analysisTime?: number; // for transient: total simulation time
  minValue?: number;
  maxValue?: number;
  finalValue?: number;
  tau?: number; // time constant estimate
  riseTime?: number; // 10%-90% rise time
  overshoot?: boolean;
  peakGain?: number; // for AC: peak gain in dB
  peakFrequency?: number; // for AC: peak frequency in Hz
  db3Frequency?: number; // for AC: -3dB frequency in Hz
  nodeVoltages?: Record<string, number>; // for OP: node name → volts
  notes?: string;
}

// Simulation error from worker
export interface SimulateError {
  message: string;
  rawErrors: string[];
  rawInfo: string;
}

// LLM configuration and preset types
export type ProviderPreset = 'qwen-dashscope' | 'openai' | 'gemini' | 'anthropic';

export interface LLMConfig {
  provider: ProviderPreset;
  apiKey: string;
  baseUrl: string; // user-editable
  model: string; // user-editable
}

export interface ProviderPresetInfo {
  baseUrl: string;
  model: string;
  displayName: string;
}

    model: 'qwen-vl-max',
    displayName: 'Qwen-VL (DashScope)',
  },
  openai: {
    baseUrl: 'https://api.openai.com/v1',
    model: 'gpt-4o',
    displayName: 'OpenAI',
  },
  gemini: {
    baseUrl: 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai',
    model: 'gemini-1.5-pro',
    displayName: 'Gemini (OpenAI-compatible)',

  anthropic: {
    baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
    model: 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022',
    displayName: 'Anthropic Claude',
  },
};

// Application settings (persisted)
export interface AppSettings {
  llm: LLMConfig | null;
  storageMode: 'session' | 'local';
  language: 'en' | 'zh-CN';
}

// Captured image data
export interface CapturedImage {
  base64: string;
  mimeType: string;
  filename?: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
}

// Demo and sample assets
export interface SampleAsset {
  id: string;
  svgPath: string;
  netlistPath?: string;
  cannedExplanation?: {
    en: string;
    'zh-CN': string;
  };
  netlistText?: string; // inline for bundled examples
}

export type DemoStep = 'idle' | 'intro-animation' | 'transcribing' | 'simulating' | 'done';

// Homework check result
export interface HomeworkCheckResult {
  field: string;
  expected: number;
  actual: number | null;
  errorPct: number | null;
  pass: boolean;
  explanation: {
    en: string;
    'zh-CN': string;
  };
}

// Simulation state machine
export type SimulationState = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'running' | 'complete' | 'error';

// Error types
export class LLMError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public provider: ProviderPreset,
    public statusCode: number,
    message: string
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'LLMError';
  }
}

import type { SimResult, AnalysisType } from '@/shared/types';
import {
  applyGlow,
  clearGlow,
  applyScanlines,
  getFlickerAlpha,
  motionAllowed,
} from './phosphor-effects';

export interface ScopeViewState {
  voltsPerDiv: number;
  timePerDiv: number;
  channels: Array<{
    enabled: boolean;
    variableIndex: number; // Index into SimResult.data
    color: string; // e.g. '#39ff14'
  }>;
  analysisType: AnalysisType;
}

export interface ScopeMetrics {
  pixelsPerDiv: number;
  voltsPerPx: number;
  timePerPx: number;
  centreX: number;
  centreY: number;
  canvasWidth: number;
  canvasHeight: number;
}

/**
 * Auto-scale detector: pick volts/div and time/div to fill ~80% of viewport
 */
function autoScale(
  simResult: SimResult,
  analysisType: AnalysisType,
  canvasWidth: number,
  canvasHeight: number
): { voltsPerDiv: number; timePerDiv: number } {
  const oneTwoFive = [
    0.001, 0.002, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000,
    2000, 5000,
  ];
  const gridHeight = canvasHeight / 2; // 8 divs
  const gridWidth = canvasWidth / 2; // 10 divs

  let voltsPerDiv = 1;
  let timePerDiv = 1;

  // For transient analysis: detect voltage and time ranges
  if (analysisType === 'tran' && simResult.data.length > 0) {
    const timeData = simResult.data[0]?.values as number[];
    const maxTime = Math.max(...(timeData || [1]));
    const voltData = simResult.data.slice(1).flatMap((ch) => {
      if (typeof ch.values[0] === 'number') return ch.values as number[];
      return [];
    });
    const maxVolt = Math.max(...voltData, 1);
    const minVolt = Math.min(...voltData, 0);
    const voltRange = Math.abs(maxVolt - minVolt) || 1;

    // Pick a voltsPerDiv that fills ~80% of grid (8 divs total, want to use ~6.4)
    for (let vpd of oneTwoFive) {
      if (voltRange / vpd <= 6.4) {
        voltsPerDiv = vpd;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Pick a timePerDiv that fills ~80% of grid (10 divs total, want to use ~8)
    for (let tpd of oneTwoFive) {
      if (maxTime / tpd <= 8) {
        timePerDiv = tpd;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  return { voltsPerDiv, timePerDiv };
}

/**
 * Decimate trace data to at most 2 points per pixel column
 * Uses min/max binning for each column
 */
function decimateTrace(
  times: number[],
  values: number[],
  pixelsPerX: number
): Array<{ t: number; v: number }> {
  if (times.length === 0) return [];
  if (pixelsPerX >= 1) {
    // No decimation needed
    return times.map((t, i) => ({ t, v: values[i] }));
  }

  const pointsPerPixel = 1 / pixelsPerX;
  const decimated: Array<{ t: number; v: number }> = [];
  let bin: { tStart: number; tEnd: number; vMin: number; vMax: number; indices: number[] } | null =
    null;

  for (let i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
    const pixelCol = Math.floor(times[i] * pixelsPerX);
    const v = values[i];

    if (!bin || Math.floor(bin.tStart * pixelsPerX) !== pixelCol) {
      // Flush previous bin
      if (bin) {
        decimated.push({ t: (bin.tStart + bin.tEnd) / 2, v: (bin.vMin + bin.vMax) / 2 });
      }
      bin = { tStart: times[i], tEnd: times[i], vMin: v, vMax: v, indices: [i] };
